# linear_initiative_label (Resource)

Workspace initiative label or label group. Deleting a group also deletes its children and removes their assignments. Import by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linear_initiative_label" "portfolio" {
  name        = "Portfolio"
  description = "Coordinates projects around a shared release or rollout"
}

resource "linear_initiative_label" "theme" {
  name       = "Theme"
  is_group   = true
  group_type = "multiSelect"
}

resource "linear_initiative_label" "platform" {
  name      = "Platform"
  parent_id = linear_initiative_label.theme.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the initiative label.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Color of the initiative label.
- `description` (String) Description of the initiative label.
- `group_type` (String) Group selection behavior: singleSelect or multiSelect. Only valid for groups; Linear defaults new groups to singleSelect.
- `is_group` (Boolean) Whether the initiative label is a group (parent) label. **Default** `false`.
- `parent_id` (String) Identifier of the parent initiative label group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the initiative label.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import linear_initiative_label.portfolio ecb63be7-63fb-47fe-95fc-1585d24e172d
```
